messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
This probably starts off like most of your typical bad roommate stories, but I assure you this is going to be worse than you might imagine.

output.original_text: This probably starts off like most of your typical bad roommate stories, but I assure you this is going to be worse than you might imagine.
output.joy: This probably starts off like most of your typical bad roommate stories, but I promise, this one is going to be so much more entertaining than you might expect!
output.sadness: This probably starts off like most of your typical bad roommate stories, but I fear this one is going to be even more heartbreaking than you might imagine.
output.fear: This probably starts off like most of your typical bad roommate stories, but I have to warn you, this is going to be much scarier than you might think.
output.anger: This probably starts off like most of your typical bad roommate stories, but believe me, this is going to be infuriating beyond your imagination!
output.surprise: This probably starts off like most of your typical bad roommate stories, but trust me, this is going to be much more shocking than you could ever guess.
output.disgust: This probably starts off like most of your typical bad roommate stories, but I assure you, this is going to be far more disgusting than you might imagine.
